Snaptune -- pitch correction (auto-tune) DSP by Nicolas Fernandez (NicoFerni).
Upstream: https://github.com/NicoFerni/snaptune
Commit: 3b8dbbb78aeed6b8a1068382c20e13f176fc664b (2026-11-19)
License: GNU AGPL v3 (see LICENSE in this directory).

Only the DSP is vendored (dsp/ = upstream Source/dsp/: AutoTuneEngine,
PitchDetector, Scales, VibratoTracker); the JUCE plugin wrapper, editor,
telemetry, update checker and KeyFinder are not. Used by NeoLooper's
Process > Autotune (src/procmods/autotune*.{hpp,cpp}), offline and in
Studio mode only (the TD-PSOLA path; Live mode is compiled but never
selected).

JUCE is NOT required: shim/ provides the handful of JUCE pieces the DSP
calls (jlimit, MathConstants, SmoothedValue, AbstractFifo, dsp::FFT) under
the same include names (juce_audio_basics/juce_audio_basics.h,
juce_dsp/juce_dsp.h). shim/ is NeoLooper's own code.

Local changes to the upstream files (marked "NeoLooper patch"):
  * dsp/AutoTuneEngine.h/.cpp: PitchFrame gains a 'time' field (the input
    sample position of the hop it describes), filled in updateCorrection(),
    so the pitch graph can be aligned with the audio.
